name: Martial Arts
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of physical conflict and self-defense, as seen when Abram armed his trained servants to rescue his brother (Genesis 14:14) and when Moses witnessed an Egyptian striking a Hebrew (Exodus 2:11). The Lord is described as a 'man of war' (Exodus 15:3), affirming His sovereign power in battle. Biblical law provides guidelines for just actions in violent encounters, such as consequences for causing harm or defending one's home (Exodus 21:22; 22:2). Ultimately, God is our strong refuge and protector (Psalms 18:31), underscoring that while physical defense may be necessary, reliance on Him remains paramount.
